# Cultural Survival

> Cultural Survival is a UN-recognized international advocacy organization dedicated to protecting Indigenous peoples' rights, self-determination, and cultural preservation through grantmaking, capacity building, and strategic advocacy.

Cultural Survival operates globally with a rights-based approach to supporting Indigenous-led initiatives. The organization manages multiple grantmaking funds and capacity-building programs while maintaining a commitment to decolonizing operations and advancing Indigenous women's leadership.

## Key Topics

- Indigenous Rights
- Self-Determination
- Cultural Preservation
- UNDRIP (UN Declaration on the Rights of Indigenous Peoples)
- Indigenous-Led Grantmaking
- Community Media
- Capacity Building
- Indigenous Youth Leadership
- Indigenous Women's Leadership
- Keepers of the Earth Fund
- Indigenous Community Media Fund
- Advocacy
- Indigenous Peoples
- Land Rights
- Human Rights

## Mission & Organization

- [About Us](https://www.culturalsurvival.org/about): About Cultural Survival's UN-recognized mission for Indigenous rights advocacy
- [Our Values and Principles](https://www.culturalsurvival.org/our-values-and-principles): Cultural Survival's core organizational values and Indigenous-centered principles
- [Our Approach](https://www.culturalsurvival.org/our-approach): Cultural Survival's rights-based approach to grantmaking, capacity building, advocacy
- [Strategic Framework](https://www.culturalsurvival.org/strategic-framework): Strategic framework for decolonizing operations and Indigenous grantmaking programs
- [Programmatic Priorities](https://www.culturalsurvival.org/programmatic-priorities): Programmatic priorities including grantmaking, capacity building, advocacy, communications
- [Gender Balance Policy](https://www.culturalsurvival.org/gender-balance-policy): Gender balance policy for Indigenous women leadership and organizational equity

## Grantmaking Programs

- [Grantmaking: Indigenous Led Funds](https://www.culturalsurvival.org/grantmaking): Indigenous-led grantmaking funds including Keepers of Earth and Community Media
- [Keepers of the Earth Fund](https://www.culturalsurvival.org/programs/advocacy/koef): Keepers of Earth Fund providing grants to Indigenous-led grassroots organizations
- [Indigenous Community Media Fund](https://www.culturalsurvival.org/grantmaking/community-media-grants-project): Indigenous Community Media Fund supporting community radio and journalism programs

## Capacity Building & Leadership Development

- [Capacity Building](https://www.culturalsurvival.org/capacity-building): Capacity building programs including youth fellowships and writers' residencies
- [Indigenous Youth Fellowships](https://www.culturalsurvival.org/programs/community-media/youth-fellowship): Indigenous youth fellowship program for leadership development and media capacity
- [Indigenous Writers in Residence](https://www.culturalsurvival.org/indigenous-writers-in-residence): Writers in residence program supporting Indigenous journalists and advocacy writing
- [Supporting Indigenous Women's Leadership in Media](https://www.culturalsurvival.org/supporting-indigenous-womens-leadership-in-media): Training program for Indigenous women's leadership in community radio and journalism
- [Defending Our Human Rights as Indigenous Women Project](https://www.culturalsurvival.org/defending-our-human-rights-as-indigenous-women): Human rights training project for Indigenous women activists in Latin America

## Issues & Advocacy
